justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Neurological rehab evidence base is strong; NCS-specific comparative outcomes absent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS exam plus 2,000 hours neurologic clinical experience; major career investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to any neurological PT caseload; broadly useful across stroke, TBI, MS, and Parkinson programs.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No NCS-specific billing premium; some specialty neuro programs recognize it for program credentialing.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: High demand in inpatient rehab and neuro specialty PT; ~10,000 holders; among more sought-after ABPTS certs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Neurological patients and families value specialist expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Neuro niches (Parkinson's, MS, post-stroke wellness, vestibular) have meaningful cash-pay and concierge demand.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: NCS supports premium positioning in vestibular and neuro-wellness cash markets.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Relatively rare credential — strong professional differentiator.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: A neuro specialty clinic can be staffed by trained generalists around an NCS-led model.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't know NCS but actively seek neuro specialists.
justifications.business.efficiency: Substantial clinical hours and exam prep required.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ABPTS NCS is among the most respected credentials in PT academia.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: NCS holders heavily populate neuro rehab research and EDGE task forces.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Maps directly to core DPT neuro curriculum across multiple courses.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying neuro rehab evidence base is robust and rapidly growing.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently required/preferred for neuro faculty lines.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Time cost is real but efficient relative to academic payoff.
